bundle.shortDescription: TTOBAK — record desktop meetings with system audio
bundle.longDescription: TTOBAK Mac App captures system audio from desktop meetings (Zoom, Teams) using macOS ScreenCaptureKit and uploads recordings to the TTOBAK meeting workspace.
